topic: Indoor/Outdoor inventory design and traffic flow
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on refining the design and calculation of indoor inventory, particularly concerning traffic flow assumptions. It was noted that while initial calculations for indoor areas assumed two-way traffic, some locations, such as airports, may feature strictly one-way paths (e.g., check-in or passport control lines). The need to adjust the current indoor roads solution based on these potential single-direction constraints was identified. Suggestions were made regarding how to map transitions between indoor and outdoor areas, including vertical movement between floors and placement of frames in glass that is visible both inside and outside.
decisions: The detailed design for indoor inventory calculation needs revision due to potential one-way traffic paths.
action_items: Discuss the best approach for handling floor transitions and outdoor/indoor frame placement during a meeting.
